## Independent review report

- **Base:** `21dde6d0d813acd4a1aa5dd7b2b42973bacad487`
- **Candidate:** `1b8726e4b4edb61b8370e5100edf11c0f1e525e0`
- **Reviewed scope:** `.factory/initiatives/I0001/jobs/J008/acceptance-matrix.json`; `tests/v1-acceptance.mjs`; assigned evidence excerpts.
- **Identity limitation:** I relied on the supplied candidate pin and host observations; I could not independently verify the Git objects or rerun checks.

### Standards — pass

The supplied diff makes the matrix status reflect the recorded operator acceptance while retaining pending technical review. The test requires that status when acceptance is recorded and rejects the former awaiting-acceptance status. This is a focused, coherent change; the probe also passed the acceptance-structure and adjacent domain tests.

### Spec — inconclusive

The assigned mappings are addressed below, but the supplied evidence is not enough to independently establish all of their broader claims. Several mappings depend on historical workflow reports or source not supplied in full; the brief also says the current plan was not supplied in full or newly verified. The explicit operator quote supports acceptance of *reported jobs*, not outstanding checks, deployment, or universal product behavior. The matrix and brief preserve those limits appropriately.

| ID | Assessment from supplied evidence |
|---|---|
| AGT-01, AGT-02 | Pinned job configuration and task-preparation excerpts support bounded delegation/context; not a universal dispatcher or full-conversation guarantee. |
| AGT-04 | Pinned methodology tests and retained workflow evidence support unchanged execution inputs in bounded cases; no live mutation test for every skill/role. |
| GND-01 | Current intake source/test supports reuse, changed-input reconciliation, and duplicate handling in tested cases; no global issue census. |
| GND-02 | Retained ancestry-regression review supports one reproduced defect and correction; not universal diagnosis. |
| GND-04 | The supplied retained proposal is explicitly provisional, supporting the stated bounded case; it does not establish current implementation status. |
| GND-05 | Coordinator guidance and the supplied workflow account support inline handling in this case; not automatic classification. |
| GND-06, GND-07 | The supplied source map and grounding guidance support navigation and re-grounding practice; they do not establish all mapped sources or guarantee correct navigation. |
| DEL-07 | Retained reports support bounded read-only closure without a fabricated PR; prose alone is not execution evidence. |
| MOD-05 | Pinned successor logic and the passing synthetic test support explicit configuration-change binding and preservation of old pins; no live resumed-worker proof. |
| TRI-01–TRI-05 | Current intake source and passing public test support the bounded prepare, uncertainty, authority, reuse, and duplicate behaviors exercised; attestations are cooperative, not authenticated identity. |
| OPS-02 | The matrix and retained real-worker excerpt support bounded asynchronous work; they do not establish universal scheduling or chat-server guarantees. |

**Finding — information:** The broad Spec mappings remain partly dependent on reports and records whose full contents were not supplied. This limits independent semantic verification; it is not evidence that the mappings are false.

### Checks and limitations

The host-selected command passed on the pinned candidate:

`node tests/v1-acceptance.mjs /work && node tests/issue-intake.mjs /work && node tests/worker-methodology.mjs /work && node tests/successor-model-config.mjs /work`

I did not run commands. The probe does not establish semantic correctness of every matrix row, client deployment, or the separate publication gates; the brief identifies exact PR/main CI as separate. No provider calls were made.

**Aggregate: inconclusive.** Standards passes for the supplied change; Spec remains inconclusive on the available evidence. This is a review report, not merge permission or product acceptance.

priorMaterialFinding.report:
## Independent review report

**Base:** `2e959789d2eb85904be374bfc21a32a2b297a7da`  
**Candidate:** `21dde6d0d813acd4a1aa5dd7b2b42973bacad487`  
**Reviewed scope:** J008 reconciliation mappings for **AGT-03, GND-03, DEL-01–06, RET-01–05, NAV-01–05, PRD-01–03**, plus the supplied candidate diff and relevant pinned context. This is not a review of the other 40 criteria.

### Standards — fail

**Suggestion — contradictory acceptance status.** `.factory/initiatives/I0001/jobs/J008/acceptance-matrix.json:4,7–13` records `operatorAcceptance` as `explicit-operator-acceptance-recorded` and includes the operator’s quote, but its `status` says `...awaiting-independent-review-and-operator-acceptance`. The latter is stale relative to the same artifact and the supplied plan/delivery text. This makes the reconciliation record internally inconsistent. Update the status to reflect that operator acceptance is recorded while technical review/publication remain pending, and add a regression check for that consistency.

The host-selected probe passed its structural checks, but `tests/v1-acceptance.mjs` does not detect this status contradiction. I found no other demonstrated Standards violation in the supplied diff.

### Spec — fail

The acceptance decision is recorded, and the supplied plan and delivery text appropriately distinguish it from pending technical gates. However, the matrix’s status still says operator acceptance is pending. That conflicts with the brief’s requirement to record the actual decision accurately. The supplied evidence supports the assigned mappings’ stated bounded scopes and qualifications in several cases—notably the synthetic NAV-02 finding, J004’s retrospective controls, and the bounded restart evidence—but does not resolve this artifact-level inconsistency.

### Checks and limitations

The pinned host observation reports that this command passed on the candidate:

`node tests/v1-acceptance.mjs /work && node tests/initiative-next-action.mjs /work && node tests/restart-baseline.mjs /work`

I did not run commands. No full public-quality run or exact final PR/main CI result is supplied; the assignment states those publication gates remain pending. Several historical claims are supported here by excerpts and pinned record hashes rather than the full underlying reports, so this review does not independently verify every historical PR, review, or CI detail. It does not certify live behavior, client use, deployment, or whole-v1 acceptance.

**Aggregate: fail.** The status inconsistency is unresolved. This report is not merge permission or product acceptance.
priorMaterialFinding.resolution: The stale awaiting-operator-acceptance status was corrected at 1b8726e4b4edb61b8370e5100edf11c0f1e525e0 with a direct negative regression; subsequent Standards verdicts pass. Their semantic verdicts still remain inconclusive.

limits: All source classifications in the matrix are coordinator evidence assessments, not an independent claim that all 61 behaviors passed.
The source artifact can be reviewed for faithful reconciliation without promoting the historical semantic verdicts. Publication, runtime verification and operator acceptance are distinct.
Each actual native review above consumed one HTTP200 SDK attempt/fetch. A report statement that no provider calls were made is not transport evidence; public probes did not invoke providers.
Client deployment remains unverified; the shared-store counterexample and all individual bounded-control limits remain in force.
